instruction.name: vrotr.d
instruction.description: Rotate right each unsigned 64-bit element in `a` by the corresponding element of `b` modulo 64, store the result in `dst`.

experiments.name: operand dependency chain
experiments.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -512; vld $vr1, $r20, 0; vld $vr2, $r20, 16; xvld $xr1, $r20, 0; xvld $xr2, $r20, 32' --asm 'vrotr.d $vr0, $vr1, $vr2; vadd.b $vr1, $vr0, $vr0'

latencies.notes: Two cycles from either source. The chain feeds the rotated result back into the source through one vadd.b (1 cycle, subtracted); chaining two rotates reads 4.00 cycles, i.e. 2 cycles each. A chain that lets the destination feed itself measures 1 cycle because the self-dependency is renamed away, so the closing arithmetic is needed to see the real latency.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: vrotr.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vrotr.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vrotr.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vrotr.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vrotr.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vrotr.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vrotr.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vrotr.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23
throughput.command: ./bench --method slope --unroll 50 --unroll2 200 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 20 --core 0 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -512; vld $vr1, $r20, 0; vld $vr2, $r20, 16; xvld $xr1, $r20, 0; xvld $xr2, $r20, 32' --asm 'vrotr.d $vr0, $vr8, $vr16; vrotr.d $vr1, $vr9, $vr17; vrotr.d $vr2, $vr10, $vr18; vrotr.d $vr3, $vr11, $vr19; vrotr.d $vr4, $vr12, $vr20; vrotr.d $vr5, $vr13, $vr21; vrotr.d $vr6, $vr14, $vr22; vrotr.d $vr7, $vr15, $vr23'
throughput.notes: Eight independent destinations with distinct source registers; the rotate occupies the vector ALU for two cycles, so the sustained rate is 2 instructions per cycle.

notes: Vector rotate of each element: 2 cycles from the source and a sustained 2 instructions per cycle. The narrow and wide elements behave the same.
